entries.text: I've beaten tougher demons then you even know!
You puny humans will be my snacks!
May the embrace of darkness kill you!
I'm the one and only mistress of shadows!
I CAN SENSE YOUR BODY ROTTING!

actions.text: Gaz'haragoth begins to draw on the nightmares to HEAL himself!
Gaz'haragoth begins to channel DEATH AND DOOM into the area! RUN!
Gaz'haragoth calls down: DEATH AND DOOM!
LADY TENEBRIS BEGINS TO CHANNEL A POWERFULL SPELL! TAKE COVER!
